S0858.reason: The Sulawesi cave art includes animal paintings and hand stencils dated to at least 35,000-40,000 years ago.

S0860.reason: If the Moon's orbital plane coincided with the ecliptic, solar eclipses would occur every new moon, making them much more frequent.

S0861.reason: The Thule culture used hide boats and spread across the Arctic from Alaska to Greenland around 700 years ago.

S0864.reason: Experiments with replicated stone points from Kathu Pan suggest Homo erectus used spears with stone points for hunting about 500,000 years ago.

S0866.reason: Ben Cartwright was the father, not one of the sons, on 'Bonanza'.
